source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.12.1, printed page 283.

blocks.text: Sulfa drugs antibacterial sulfonamides hain aur in mein sulfur hoti hai; penicillins aur cephalosporins mein bhi sulfur hoti hai. Aam dawa omeprazole, jo GERD (gastroesophageal reflux disease, yani maide ka tezab khuraak ki nali mein wapas aana) mein di jati hai, sulfoxide group rakhti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki ibarat se lagta hai ke penicillins aur cephalosporins sulfonamides ki misalein hain. Yeh ghalat hai: penicillins aur cephalosporins sulfonamides nahi, beta-lactam antibiotics hain. Haan, in ke rings mein bhi sulfur hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Omeprazole mein kaun sa sulfur group hai, aur –SO₂NH– group wali antibacterial dawaon ko kya kehte hain?
blocks.explanation: Omeprazole mein sulfoxide group, R–S(=O)–R, hai. –SO₂NH– (sulfonamide) group wali antibacterial dawaen sulfonamides yani sulfa drugs hain.

items: Sulfa drugs = sulfonamides; penicillins aur cephalosporins ke rings mein bhi sulfur; omeprazole mein sulfoxide group.
